text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard a teen 
magazine is coming to the academy for an 
interview soon.

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know how they sometimes publish 
articles introducing the girls at Tracen 
Academy?

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A while ago, there was this huge photo of 
me sprinting around a corner in the paper, 
and I was pretty happy about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not hiding...! It's just a 
coincidence...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Being featured front and center in a 
magazine is a bit..."

Even after that, Mejiro Dober's puzzling 
behavior continued, and training drew to a 
close leaving a sense of incompletion...
